SAS DDFM=KR stress_fit(spec)                                   # the pre-specified analysis, one row # or from a fitted model / an ADaM BDS: stress_spec_mmrm(fit, reference = "PBO"); stress_spec_adam(adeff, "PARAM1")  cen <- stress_census(spec,   stress_covariance(spec),                         # us, ar1h, ar1, cs, csh, toep, toeph   stress_inference(spec),                          # Satterthwaite, KR, linear KR, residual, sandwich, jackknife   stress_covariates(spec),                         # drop each covariate, drop all   stress_population(spec, list(female = function(d) d$SEX == "Female")),   stress_loo(spec, by = "RACE"),                   # leave-one-group-out   stress_permute(spec, n = 500),                   # re-randomisation p   stress_tipping(spec, deltas = seq(0, -10, -2)),  # delta-adjusted MI (FCS regression)   stress_reference(spec),                          # MAR, J2R, CR, CIR reference-based MI   stress_estimator(spec, random = "SITE"),         # complete cases, GEE independence, ANCOVA, robust ANCOVA, random intercept   stress_fragility(spec, "significance"),          # smallest subject set whose removal flips significance (greedy)   stress_weights(spec))                            # equal vs observed-margins LS-mean weighting summary(cen)          # per-family table: counted, significant, crossed, outside CI, reversed, % of base stress_verdict(cen)   # robust / sensitive / fragile, with a marginal flag plot(cen)             # one row per family on the percent-of-base axis plot_swarm(cen)       # bubble swarm of distinct estimates against the no-difference line, deletions beneath plot_pstrip(cen)      # leave-one-out p-values on a log axis, the base as a diamond tp <- stress_tipping(spec, deltas = seq(0, -10, -2)) tipping_point(tp)     # the recommended set, pre-specified, run and reported in one go plan <- standard_plan(spec, site = "SITE", strata = "SITE", baseline = "BASE", deltas = seq(0, -10, -2)) res <- run_plan(plan, cores = 6) stress_report(res, dir = "stress")    # Markdown + figures stress_tables(res, dir = "stress")    # CSV, Word, RTF stress_html(res, "stress/report.html") # interactive stress_log(res, "stress/log.json")    # audit trail with the plan hash  # or build your own plan plan <- stress_plan(spec, loo = list(list(), list(by = "SITE")), tipping = list(deltas = seq(0, -10, -2)),                     estimator = list(random = "SITE", baseline = "BASE")) plan                                  # text: "complete_cases": pre-specified MMRM subjects observed every visit (reliance missing--random within likelihood). "gee_independence": working-independence weighted least squares visit-specific residual variance cluster-robust (sandwich) variance, -within degrees freedom; within-subject covariance modelled. Needs nlme. "ancova": analysis covariance contrast visit, observed cases, residual degrees freedom. Covariate terms involving visit variable dropped. "robust_ancova": MM-type robust regression contrast visit (MASS::rlm), normal-theory inference. Needs MASS. "clda": constrained longitudinal data analysis: raw outcome (baseline plus response, must change baseline) modelled baseline every post-baseline visit one common baseline mean across arms, unstructured covariance visits covariates fixed effects; contrast difference arms' means contrast visit. Needs baseline.
